pages.title: Get the Guide
pages.text: Install Patchouli for your Minecraft version and loader on the server and clients. This guide appears in the Simply Screens creative tab. Craft another copy with a book and an amethyst shard.

pages.title: Optional Guide
pages.text: Simply Screens works without Patchouli. Only this guide and its recipe are unavailable. Use Playlists to save and play slideshows, and Queue for one-off images. The player controls remain available in every tab.
